The '''Guardian of the Mounds''' was a title given to inhabitants of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and marked their efforts against the threat posed by the [[Killik/Legends|Killiks]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], [[Rylan Stallos]] of [[House of Thul|House Thul]] tasked an official of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] with poisoning Killik hives in order to lead the [[Insectoid/Legends|insectoids]] attacking the other [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] houses. This forced them to take their responsibility in culling the Killik numbers and Stallos commented to the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] representative that they would had made a fine royal Guardian of the Mounds.
